# Assessment Plan - InsEmpodera

The target is an ASP.NET Core MVC application.

## Objectives
1. Perform thorough white-box analysis of the C# code.
2. Identify authentication/authorization mechanisms and potential flaws.
3. Assess input handling in controllers for injection vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, etc.).
4. Validate findings dynamically.
5. Report findings and propose fixes.

## Tasks
- [ ] Map repository structure and entry points (Controllers).
- [ ] Analyze authentication and authorization implementation (`AccountController`, `AccessProfileController`).
- [ ] Perform SAST analysis (semgrep, ast-grep, trivy) to find high-risk code.
- [ ] Identify and validate potential IDOR/BOLA, SQLi, SSRF, XSS.
- [ ] Document and report findings.

## Subagents
- `Code Analysis Agent` (SAST, Mapping)
- `Auth & Logic Agent` (Deep dive into auth/authz)
- `Validation Agents` (for each finding)
